name: Jannah Hilal
summary: A generous crescent cradles a flourishing garden, with a spring flowing through its open side.
why: The crescent becomes the garden's protective outer form, rather than a small added badge. Three gold leaves open inside it and a flowing band of water crosses the lower opening, joining a familiar Islamic visual reference to the original hope-and-renewal idea.
risk: The crescent can emphasize Ramadan or the lunar calendar; its Islamic association is clearer than its prayer-time function.
